system.description: By mixing a Blood Trait with dead rose petals and reciting the incantation, the ritualist makes it impossible for the target to retain more than three Blood Traits in her body; excess Blood Traits force a turn of vomiting, and further feeding triggers immediate nausea until the excess is purged. This may force a hunger frenzy check at the Storyteller's discretion, but does not induce torpor. This ritual lasts one evening and has no effect on Kindred older than the caster.
